set.body:
Source: 2026-08-03 quality review.

Problem: textTimeLimit matched only D-HH:MM:SS, HH:MM:SS and bare minutes. Three documented shapes fell through to ObservedTimeLimit.Unknown, which an operator reads as "the site did not report a limit". MM:SS is the one that matters: squeue renders every limit under an hour that way, so a routine 30-minute job reported no limit at all. D-HH and D-HH:MM were also unhandled.

Fix: added DayHourMinute, DayHour and MinuteSecond patterns, reusing the existing durationMinutes rounding so a sub-minute limit still rounds up as elsewhere. Scala regex patterns match the whole string, so the new two-part shapes cannot capture a three-part one.

Evidence: RED first. A table-driven test over all six shapes plus bare minutes failed before the change and passes after. No fixture needed: these are Slurm-documented output formats, not site-specific behaviour.
set.title: P8.A13: Parse every documented Slurm duration shape, including MM:SS
